name: Adelaide University
summary: South Australia's Adelaide University: City, Mawson Lakes, Roseworthy and Waite campuses, with degrees that start in February or July.

ib.text: Each degree sets a minimum IB total for 2027: Arts, Science and Business 25, Computer Science 26, Civil Engineering 28. Prerequisites such as SACE Mathematical Methods 'or equivalent' apply to some degrees.

apply.via: Adelaide University online application (direct or agent)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) (Honours)
programmes.about: Four years in civil engineering with common first-year subjects that let you switch specialisation, up to 12 weeks of industry placement, an honours research project and an industry design project.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 28 IB points and the Mathematical Methods prerequisite (SACE Stage 2 or equivalent); ask which IB maths course counts.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive entry ranked on your IB total against the 2027 minimum for your country of study.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) (Honours): common first year, up to 12 weeks of industry placement

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: Three years across the natural and physical sciences, from the sub-atomic to the planetary, building analytical methods, laboratory and field techniques and IT skills; taught across four campuses.
programmes.ib: 2027 entry needs 25 IB points; prerequisites depend on the major.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive entry ranked on your IB total against the 2027 minimum for your country of study.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science: natural and physical sciences taught across the City, Mawson Lakes, Roseworthy and Waite campuses

notes: This is the newly merged Adelaide University; older University of Adelaide pages sit on the same website, so use degree pages branded Adelaide University.
Closing dates differ by degree and are on each degree's page; no general international closing date is published.
Part-time study is not available to international students.
